title: Pentaryn Rules Lookup
description: Full-text search across the owned rulebooks, from one call. Exposes game.pentaryn.rules.search() / .page() (with embedded roll tables) / .monster() (with {text: true}: enriched feature text) / .monsters() (by size, type, CR) / .names() (PHB class, subclass, species, background and feat names) / .onList() / .spellList() / .packs() / .selftest(). Read-only: it never writes a document. Searches the Player's Handbook, Dungeon Master's Guide and 2024 SRD by default; Monster Manual text and the 2014 SRD are opt-in, and 2014 hits are stamped with their edition so they cannot be mistaken for current rules. Every hit carries a pasteable Compendium UUID.
